contexts.text: An infant is born black from a black or Moor by a white or European woman, and conversely.

That the Moors or Africans seek to be white. - I have heard that the Moors or Negroes, as the Africans, in the other life do not want to be black, but white. They esteem whiteness as beauty, after they have been prepared; because the Angels of God Messiah are all bright white; and the interior ones love to be clothed in white garments.
